answer_2.quote: The evaluation metrics for ACE04, ACE05 and SciERC include Ent, Rel, and Rel+, all in micro-F1 score. ... we adopt four recently proposed state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines as the backbones to augment them with our proposed RTE-GMoE framework ... Overall, RTE-GMoE demonstrates consistent and promising performance improvements, achieving higher precision, recall, and F1 scores across various benchmarks.
